```{r}
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
playdat_full <- readRDS(here::here("..", "Data Clean", "trihurdle-metaanalysis_more-predictors_playdat-full.rds"))
```

```{r}
condition_names <- readRDS(here::here("..", "Data Clean", "condition-names_more-predictors.rds"))
```


#### Functions
```{r}
source(here::here("Scripts", "predictor-automation.R"))
```

#### Cleaning
```{r}
study.level_predictors <- str_split(condition_names[1], regex("\\.[lmh]{1}_")) |> 
  map(~ str_split_i(.x, "\\.", 1)) |>
  pluck(1) %>%
  tail(6)
```

### Midpoint Hurdle Prior

Messing around with the prior specification for the standard deviation of the variance component of the cluster effects of the midpoint hurdle.

`student_t_lpdf(sd_7 | 3, 0, 2.5) - 1 * student_t_lccdf(0 | 3, 0, 2.5)`

```{r}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3
#| layout-ncol: 4
nu <- 3
mu <- 0
sigma <- 2.5

expand_grid(alpha = c(1), beta = c(10, 2, 1.5, 0.5)) |>
  pwalk(\(alpha, beta) {
    (data.frame(i = seq(0, 10, length.out = 1000)) |>
         mutate(dens_t = dt((i - mu) / sigma, df = nu) / sigma * 2,
                dens_g = dgamma(i, shape = alpha, scale = beta)) |>
         ggplot(aes(x = i, y = dens_t)) +
         geom_line() +
         geomtextpath::geom_textline(aes(y = dens_g,
                                         label = paste0("gamma(", alpha, 
                                                        ", ", beta, ")")),
                                     color = "skyblue3", size = 6) +
         coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 10), ylim = c(0, .5),
                         expand = F, clip = "off") +
         guides(y = "none") +
         labs(y = NULL, x= NULL) +
         theme_classic(base_size = 16)) |>
      print()})
```




```{r, echo = F, message = F}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 16
#| out-width: 100%
#| column: margin

cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = 
                     list(readRDS(here::here("Figures", "Tri-Hurdle Metaanalysis", "p_DAC_forestplt_legend.rds")),
                          readRDS(here::here("Figures", "Tri-Hurdle Metaanalysis", "p_DAC_forestplt.rds")) +
                            scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1),
                                               labels = scales::percent_format(),
                                               position = "top",
                                               expand = c(0, 0)) +
                            coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
                            theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 0, 1),
                                  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5),
                                  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))),
                   ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.042, 1))

```
